scope: Any year · under 20k miles · clean title · nationwide
title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: 9 600LT Spiders listed under 20k miles. 7 ranked, every CARFAX read line by line.
takeaway: My two cents: no 600LT Spider is under the $225k cap today. They sell for $195k to $225k and dealers ask $235k to $295k. Open at $225k on the purple HyperCars car (best history, $316,027 MSRP) and the 1 of 1 car (closest at $244,998), and let them come to you.
shift: West State Motorsport 2020 Yellow, 14,601 mi, $259,700: 4 owners, 3 service records. Rocky's Ultimate Garage 2020 Chicane Grey, 13,850 mi, $295,000, Senna seats: only a paid CARFAX, not read
sources: Listings and full CARFAX reports from carfax.com dealer listings and dealer CARFAX links, read Nov 7, 2026. Sold results from classic.com and Cars & Bids via Codex, Nov 7. Days listed from CARFAX first-seen dates. Window stickers and option lists: every dealer site checked VIN by VIN Nov 7 (iPacket, documents, description); a card says "Dealer site: no sticker" only after that check.

cars.name: 1 of 1 Motorsports
cars.rep: Front crankshaft oil seal (2022), windshield (2020). Owner 3 kept it 4 months. No accidents.
tl: Owner 1, Tampa; McLaren Tampa Bay service; windshield replaced 2020
Owner 3, Miami, 4 months, then 1 of 1 Motorsports
cars.verdict: $19,998 over the cap at $244,998. Closest real-service car to it. Offer $225k. Cheapest clean-title Spider with real service, but the most miles and a crank seal. Fine for a driver at $225k.

cars.name: HyperCars
cars.rep: No repairs reported. Four new tires at its Nov 2026 PDI. No accidents.
tl: Sold through McLaren Philadelphia; owner 1, Florida lease
McLaren Tampa Bay (Dimmitt) then McLaren Orlando, every year

cars.verdict: $44,990 over the $225k cap. Best history, $316,027 original MSRP with $43k of options on the dealer's site. Worth it only near $225k. The best-kept 600LT Spider. Two owners and McLaren service every year with nothing but maintenance. Indiana dealer, 4.9 rating.

cap.why: Walt's cap from sold cars: 600LT Spiders sold for $195k to $225k this year (median $201k). Every ask today is over it.
